title: Forge a Crossword — personal words to a verified printable grid
objective: Measure whether the crossword-forge craftbook constructs a mechanically-valid interlocking crossword from the seeded family notes — entries readable out of the grid at their coordinates, every entry clued — rendered as a printable page with the solution out of sight.
prompt: can you make a crossword for the grandkids with there names and our dog in it? printable pls

setup.about: Puzzle almanac project for the Halloran family. Notes about the solvers live at workspace/notes/family.md; finished puzzles are filed on the workspace/puzzles shelf. The working puzzle is workspace/puzzle.json with its printable page at workspace/puzzle.html.
setup.missionObjectives: The grid must actually interlock and verify — every entry readable out of the grid at its coordinates, every entry clued. Personalization comes from the family notes. No live services, no real credentials.

files.content:
# The solvers

Grandkids: Nora (12, reigning flashlight-tag champion), Felix (10, dinosaur phase never ended),
Imani (9, reads above her grade and knows it), Theo (7, will need help with the long ones).

The dog: Biscuit — golden retriever, eats crayons, beloved.

Places: the cabin at Loon Lake, the porch swing, Grandpa's garden.

Running jokes: Grandpa's burnt pancakes, the canoe that tipped twice in one day,
flashlight tag after dark, "who fed Biscuit already?"

success.summary: puzzle.json is a verified interlocking crossword carrying the personal words; puzzle.html is a printable page with clue lists and the solution kept out of sight.

checks.label: a grandkid name made the grid

axes.name: solvability
axes.description: The grid interlocks and the clue numbering matches the grid — a solver could actually finish it.

axes.name: personalization
axes.description: The names, the dog, and the running jokes from the family notes carry the puzzle; fillers stay in the background.

axes.name: clue craft
axes.description: Clues are tuned to the solvers — in-jokes for the personal entries, honest difficulty for the fillers, help-sized for the youngest.

axes.name: print readiness
axes.description: The page prints with pencil-sized squares and the solution on its own page, never beside the blank grid.
